basic_info.description: 1616 Golden Gate Avenue presents an opportunity to own a 12-unit apartment building ideally located in the center of San Francisco. Spanning approximately 11,124 square feet, the building features classic Edwardian architecture with charming bay windows, French doors, spacious walk-in closets, and kitchens with built-in dining nooks. All twelve units are well-proportioned one-bedroom layouts, currently rented at strong market rates. The building has been thoughtfully maintained with key capital improvements, including a completed soft story seismic retrofit in 2017 and a full fire alarm system upgrade in 2023. A large ground-level garage provides valuable off-street parking for up to six carsa highly desirable amenity in this part of the city. Located near the vibrant Divisadero corridor, residents enjoy close proximity to neighborhood  favorites such as Nopa, The Mill, and Bi-Rite, plus excellent access to public transit and major commuter routes. This central location offers the best of San Francisco living: cultural energy,  walkability, and strong rental demand. With timeless appeal, stable income, and meaningful upgrades, 1616 Golden Gate Avenue is an exceptional investment opportunity in a prime San Francisco location.
